fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-10-15 states that the complainant paid an advance of Rs. 25,000 for a machinery supply order, but the service was not provided and the payee stopped responding, on 2025-10-10 at roughly 10:50. The online submission was made by Saravanan Gopal (9000000094). The complaint mentions Nandha Karuppasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000113, in connection with the events. Padmini Raj (9000000032) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100051. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference and physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00223, as the mobile number 9000000113 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Payee reportedly stopped taking calls after receiving the advance.
fields.Keywords: advance payment, cheating, suspect, documents, witness, mobile number, market road, call detail
